description: The module system that powers Bare

members.name: Module.createRequire
signatures: Module.createRequire(parentURL: string | URL, opts?: CreateRequireOptions): Require
members.description:
Create a preconfigured `require()` bound to `parentURL`, so specifiers resolve and load
relative to it.

params.name: parentURL
params.description:
The parent URL that the returned `require()` resolves and loads specifiers
relative to.

params.name: opts
params.description: Options for the created `require()`, such as its `protocol` and `cache`.

returns.description:
A `require()` bound to `parentURL`, with `main`, `cache`, `resolve`, `addon`, and
`asset` attached.

throws.condition:
`parentURL` is neither a string nor a WHATWG `URL`, and no `referrer` was
given.

members.name: Module.load
signatures: Module.load(url: URL, source?: Buffer | string | null, opts?: LoadOptions): Promise<Module>
members.description:
Load a module with the provided `url`. `url` is a WHATWG `URL`. If provided, the `source` will
be passed to the matching `extension` for the `url`.

params.name: url
params.description: The WHATWG `URL` of the module to load.

params.name: opts
params.description:
Load options; may carry a `source` to load directly instead of reading it through
the protocol.

returns.description: The loaded `Module`, reusing the cached instance if `url` was already loaded.

throws.condition:
a module is already cached for `url` with a type incompatible with
the requested `type`.

members.name: Module.loadSync
signatures: Module.loadSync(url: URL, source?: Buffer | string | null, opts?: LoadOptions): Module
members.description:
As `load()`, but synchronous, for a caller that cannot await one. The protocol is driven
through its `*Sync` methods and so must answer synchronously. A module with a top-level
`await` is returned as soon as its evaluation is started rather than once it has finished, as
there is nothing to wait on it here.

params.name: url
params.description: The WHATWG `URL` of the module to load.

params.name: opts
params.description:
Load options; may carry a `source` to load directly instead of reading it through
the protocol.

returns.description: The loaded `Module`, reusing the cached instance if `url` was already loaded.

throws.condition:
a module is already cached for `url` with a type incompatible with
the requested `type`.

members.name: Module.resolve
signatures: Module.resolve(specifier: string, parentURL: URL, opts?: ResolveOptions): Promise<URL>
Module.resolve(specifier: string, parentURL: URL, condition: Condition, opts?: ResolveOptions): Promise<URL>
members.description:
Resolve the module `specifier` relative to the `parentURL`. `specifier` is a string and
`parentURL` is a WHATWG `URL`. `condition` is an optional import condition, defaulting to
`'require'`; pass `'asset'` to resolve an asset rather than a module.

params.name: specifier
params.description: The module specifier to resolve.

params.name: parentURL
params.description: The WHATWG `URL` to resolve `specifier` relative to.

params.name: opts
params.description: Resolution options.

throws.condition:
no module matching `specifier` could be found relative to
`parentURL`.

the `'asset'` condition was used and no matching asset could be
found.

the `'addon'` condition was used and no matching addon could be
found.

`specifier` is not a string, `parentURL` is not a WHATWG `URL`, or
`condition` is not a known condition.

members.name: Module.resolveSync
signatures: Module.resolveSync(specifier: string, parentURL: URL, opts?: ResolveOptions): URL
Module.resolveSync(specifier: string, parentURL: URL, condition: Condition, opts?: ResolveOptions): URL
members.description:
As `resolve()`, but synchronous, for a caller that cannot await one. The protocol is driven
through its `*Sync` methods and so must answer synchronously.

params.name: specifier
params.description: The module specifier to resolve.

params.name: parentURL
params.description: The WHATWG `URL` to resolve `specifier` relative to.

params.name: opts
params.description: Resolution options.

throws.condition:
no module matching `specifier` could be found relative to
`parentURL`.

`specifier` is not a string, `parentURL` is not a WHATWG `URL`, or
`condition` is not a known condition.

members.name: protocol
members.description:
The `ModuleProtocol` class for resolving, reading and loading modules. See
[Protocols](https://github.com/holepunchto/bare-module#protocols) for usage.

members.name: url
members.description: The WHATWG `URL` identifier of the module.

exports.name: Attributes
exports.description:
Import attributes instructing how a module should be loaded. A `type` that is not one of the
known strings is turned down rather than passed over.

members.name: type
members.description:
How the module should be loaded: one of `'script'`, `'module'`, `'json'`, `'bundle'`,
`'addon'`, `'binary'`, or `'text'`.

exports.name: Cache
exports.description: A map of module URL `href`s to loaded modules.

exports.name: ModuleLoader
signatures:
interface ModuleLoader {
  readonly builtins: Builtins
  readonly cache: Cache
  readonly concurrency: number
  readonly conditions: Conditions
  readonly defaultType: number
  readonly imports: ImportsMap
  readonly main: Module
  readonly protocol: Protocol
  readonly resolutions: ResolutionsMap
  get(url: URL): Module | null
  link(entry: URL, source?: Buffer | string | null, opts?: LinkOptions): Promise<Module>
  linkSync(entry: URL, source?: Buffer | string | null, opts?: LinkOptions): Module
  import(entry: URL, opts?: ImportOptions): Promise<unknown>
  importSync(entry: URL, opts?: ImportOptions): unknown
}

members.name: builtins
members.description: A map of builtin module specifiers mapped to the loaded module.

members.name: cache
members.description:
The cache of loaded modules that the loader was created with, shared with every module of its
graph.

members.name: concurrency
members.description:
The maximum number of module reads to perform concurrently while linking. `0` applies no
limit.

members.name: conditions
members.description:
An array of conditions used to resolve dependencies while loading the module. See [Conditional
exports](https://github.com/holepunchto/bare-module#conditional-exports) for possible values.

members.name: defaultType
members.description:
The assumed type of a module without a `type` using an ambiguous extension, such as `.js`. See
`Module.constants.types` for possible values.

members.name: imports
members.description: The import map when the module was loaded.

members.name: link
signatures: link(entry: URL, source?: Buffer | string | null, opts?: LinkOptions): Promise<Module>

members.name: linkSync
signatures: linkSync(entry: URL, source?: Buffer | string | null, opts?: LinkOptions): Module

members.name: main
members.description: The module representing the entry script where the program was launched.

members.name: ModuleLoader.ImportOptions
attributes
members.description:
The import attributes, for example the `{ type: 'json' }` in `import foo from 'foo' with {
type: 'json' }`.

members.name: ModuleLoader.LinkOptions
attributes

members.name: ModuleLoader.Options
signatures:
interface Options {
  builtins?: Builtins
  cache?: Cache | boolean
  concurrency?: number
  defaultType?: number
  imports?: ImportsMap
  protocol?: Protocol
  resolutions?: ResolutionsMap
}

members.name: protocol
members.description:
The `ModuleProtocol` modules are resolved and read through, shared with every module of the
loader's graph.

members.name: resolutions
members.description:
A map of preresolved imports with keys being serialized parent URLs and values being
`"imports"` maps.

exports.name: ModuleProtocol
signatures:
interface ModuleProtocol {
  resolve(url: URL): URL | Promise<URL>
  resolveSync(url: URL): URL
  exists(url: URL): boolean | Promise<boolean>
  existsSync(url: URL): boolean
  read(url: URL): Buffer | string | null | Promise<Buffer | string | null>
  readSync(url: URL): Buffer | string | null
  list(url: URL): Iterable<URL> | AsyncIterable<URL>
  listSync(url: URL): Iterable<URL>
  extend(methods: Partial<ModuleProtocol>): ModuleProtocol
}

params.name: methods
params.description:
Protocol method overrides; any of `resolve`, `resolveSync`, `exists`,
`existsSync`, `read`, `readSync`, `list`, or `listSync`.

params.name: context
params.description: An existing protocol to fall back to for any method not provided in `methods`.

members.name: exists
members.description: Return whether the URL exists.

params.name: url
params.description: The `URL` to check for existence.

returns.description: Whether `url` exists. The default implementation returns `false`.

members.name: extend
members.description: Create a new protocol that uses this protocol as its context, overriding the given `methods`.

params.name: methods
params.description: Protocol method overrides for the new protocol.

returns.description:
A new `ModuleProtocol` that uses this protocol as its context, with `methods`
overriding.

params.name: value
params.description: The value to test.

returns.description:
Whether `value` is a protocol of the same version as this one, whichever copy of
`bare-module` created it.

members.name: read
signatures: read(url: URL): Buffer | string | null | Promise<Buffer | string | null>
members.description: Return the source code of a URL, represented as a string or buffer.

params.name: url
params.description: The `URL` to read.

returns.type: Buffer | string | null | Promise<Buffer | string | null>
returns.description: The source of `url` as a `Buffer` or `string`, or `null` if it does not exist.

members.name: resolve
members.description:
Resolve a module `URL` to the `URL` that should be linked. The default implementation returns
`url` unchanged.

params.name: url
params.description: The `URL` to resolve.

returns.description: The resolved `URL`. A promise must not be returned during synchronous linking.

exports.name: RequireAddon
exports.description: The `require.addon` function: imports addon modules, with `host` and `resolve` attached.

members.name: host
members.description:
The platform and architecture used when resolving addons, following the pattern
`<platform>-<arch>[-<environment>]`.

exports.name: Require
signatures:
interface Require {
  main: Module
  cache: Cache
  resolve: (specifier: string, parentURL?: URL) => string
  addon: RequireAddon
  asset: (specifier: string, parentURL?: URL) => string
}
exports.description:
The function returned by `Module.createRequire()`: resolves and loads modules relative to its
parent URL, with `main`, `cache`, `resolve`, `addon`, and `asset` attached.

members.name: addon
members.description: Resolve `specifier` relative to `parentURL` and evaluate the matching addon.
